pull-request-header:
## What changes

This release pull request publishes the module versions described below. Merging it creates one `<module>-vX.Y.Z` tag per released module and updates each module's `CHANGELOG.md`.
pull-request-footer:
## Why

Live roots consume modules only by exact tag (MTS-IAC-102); each merged Conventional Commit to a module accumulates here until its release.

## Tasks

- ai-agents specs/001-governance-and-iac-program T022 and T023 — module releases. Generated by release-please; the register is updated by the pull request that records the release.

- [ ] The task register is updated in this pull request — generated release pull requests do not edit registers.
- [ ] Every task ticked here was verified by locating its artifact — no task is ticked.
- [x] Infrastructure changes: the documentation consulted through the required MCP servers is listed above

## How it is verified

The infrastructure-as-code gate runs on this pull request. The version and changelog come from the merged commits' Conventional Commit types; no documentation lookup applies to a release.

## Risk and rollback

A tag is immutable once consumed. To withdraw a release, publish a fixed patch version and move consumers to it; never delete or move a published tag.

## What this PR does not do

It does not change any consumer; roots move to a new tag in their own reviewed pull requests.
